DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA comer Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: //www.dilg.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 06, 2023 JAN 26 2023 HON. NELMAR T. SARMIENTO Mayor, Municipality of Jomalig Province of Quezon Dear Mayor Sarmiento: This has reference to your letter dated 07 November 2022 requesting the DILG Secretary's intercession and assistance in restoring and maintaining the peace and order in the aforesaid Municipality. In your letter, you stated that: 1. On II May 2022, Rodel T. Espiritu, former Mayor of the Municipality of Jomalig, Province of Quezon, filed an election protest before the Regional Trial Court contesting the COMELEC proclamation which declared you as the winner in the mayoralty race in said municipality; 2. On 28 October 2022, the Court promulgated its Decision declaring Mr. Espiritu as the duly elected mayor; 3. Immediately after receiving the said Decision, you perfected an appeal with the COMELEC; 4. Considering that the Decision has not yet attained finality, under prevailing rules and jurisprudence, you are of the view that you are still the presumptive winner and incumbent mayor of the Municipality of Jomalig; 5. You further manifested that since 02 November 2022, the followers and supporters of Mr. Espiritu have been planning and gaining inappropriate actions which aim to disrupt the peace and order of the community as well as in running the day-to-day affairs of the municipal government. At the outset, we would like to highlight the pronouncement of the Supreme Court in the case of Mendoza v. Laxina Sr.l, wherein it explained that the pendency of an election protest is not sufficient basis to enjoin a public officer from assuming office or from discharging his functions. Unless his election is annulled bv a final and executory decision. or a valid execution of an order unseatinq him pending appeal is issued. he has the lawful right to assume and perform the duties of the office to which he has been elected. ' G.R. NO. 146875. Jtny 14, 2003. "Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

n view thereof, there is a legal basis for you to still continue assuming and discharging the functions of the Office of the Mayor, unless the decision on the election protest has become final and executory, or former Mayor Espiritu has obtained an order granting execution pending appeal, whichever comes earlier. This opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. Please be guided accordingly. Very truly yours, BY AU ORITY OF THE SECRETARY: AN VICTOR R. LLAMAS cretary for External, Legal and Legislative Affairs Und OU LLAJVRLJLLL-LRALLD/rjki/clp copy furnished: DIR. ARIEL O.
